segments.text: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.

footnotes.text: + by…: Heb. by the hand of

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I have loved you,
saith the LORD.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob’s brother?
saith the LORD:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: yet I loved Jacob,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.
Whereas Edom saith,

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places;

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: thus saith the LORD of hosts,

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever.

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.

footnotes.text: + from: or, upon: Heb. from upon

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: ¶ A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is mine honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear?
saith the LORD of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name.

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the LORD is contemptible.

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person?
saith the LORD of hosts.

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons?
saith the LORD of hosts.

footnotes.text: + God: Heb. the face of God

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you,
saith the LORD of hosts,

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen,
saith the LORD of hosts.

segments.speaker: The people
segments.text: ¶ But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the LORD is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.

segments.speaker: The priests
segments.text: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it,
saith the LORD of hosts;

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: and ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand?
saith the LORD.

footnotes.text: + and ye have…: or, whereas ye might have blown it away

segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts
segments.text: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing: for I am a great King,
saith the LORD of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.

footnotes.text: + which…: Heb. in whose flock is
